ApeCloud builds ApeRAG for enterprise knowledge retrieval.
ApeRAG uses Hurl to validate HTTP workflows in continuous integration.
Zhang San leads the ApeRAG testing effort at ApeCloud.
ApeRAG connects PostgreSQL for metadata storage and Qdrant for vector search.
The testing team uses knowledge graphs to map relationships between ApeCloud, ApeRAG, Hurl, PostgreSQL, and Qdrant.
